source: Mmap.e5 (Ls12, 852 entries, 640x400; BMP24 -> NNN.png, JPEG -> NNN.jpg copied unchanged); archive object 0x4ac640 opened by 0x42be51

scene_lookup.rule: entry = image + 256*dword[0x505eec] + (40 if kind == 2 else 0); decoded with mode 0 (no colour key); kind 2 then re-orders the picture into 8x8 tiles (0x473d4a(buf, 0x3250, tmp, 8)) for the scene compositor - storage itself is always plain rows
scene_lookup.script_op: 0x413d13 (5 args a0..a4): a0 = kind; kind 0: image = a1 (0xffff -> 0); kind 1: image = 114 if a2 == 0, else a1, or a3 + 40 when a1 == 0xffff (a3 == 0xffff -> 114); kind 2: image = a3 (0xffff -> 0); kind 3 (battle map): image 0xff, battle map = a4 (0xffff -> 99) + 100*byte[0x505f4c] -> word 0x510cfe; then 0x428346(kind, image) stores the image BYTE
scene_lookup.bank: dword 0x505eec: picture bank, only read here (set through script memory writes)

buha.source: Pmap.e5 (Ls12, 812 entries of 20016 bytes); entry = image + 256*dword[0x505eec] (no kind offset), loader 0x425dcd -> buffer 0x401669
buha.format: header 16 bytes = 8 LE words [scene id, X=100, Y=100, Z=1, W=200, 100, 1, ?]; then a u16 grid [Z][Y][X] (0x4268ba: offset 0x10 + 2*((X*Y)*z + X*y + x)); cell low byte = object sprite id (0xff none, 0x427426), high byte 0xff / 0xf0 (walk / occlusion flags, semantics as wg2025 Buha). Exported as 200x100 greyscale = the raw bytes (lo, hi per cell), same as rea
